newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Wiluna sells gold leases to AGF.
newsitem.headline: Wiluna sells gold leases to AGF.

text.p: Wiluna Mines Ltd said on Monday it had sold its interests in certain tenements in the Miranda area of Western Australian to Australian Gold Fields NL for a mixture of cash and royalty over future production.

Wiluna said it would recieve A$7.8 million cash and three percnet royalty of over 25,000 ounces of gold in consideration for the disposal of its interests in five granted mining leases to Australian Gold Fields.
It said the Miranda joint venture with Australian Gold Fields has been amended, increasing its partners' expenditure to earn a 50 percent interest in the expanded Miranda venture.

Wiluna said the tenements sold to Australian Gold Fields include the Vivien deposit which contained a resource of about 150,00 ounces, smaller deposits at Maria and Patty, as well as the Cams and Scorpion deposits.
